item.title: Taglyan Hosts 19th Annual Living Legends Foundations Awards
item.description: With appearances and performances by the music industry's biggest stars, the Living Legends Foundation awards brought down the house at Taglyan Complex.

item.title: Pablove Foundation Event Raises $125K To Fight Childhood Cancer
item.description: The Pablove Foundation's 3rd annual Pablove One Another Luncheon raised $125,000 to fight pediatric cancer on October 23, 2019, hosted at Taglyan.

item.title: Talent Managers Association Presents The 15th Heller Awards At Taglyan
item.description: The 15th Heller Awards, presented by the Talent Managers Association, was held at the Taglyan Complex November 7th, 2019.

item.title: 5th Annual “Best of the Best” Hotel Awards Gala Held At Taglyan Complex
item.description: The 5th Annual “Best of the Best” Hotel Awards Gala were held at the Taglyan Complex on November 19th, 2019. We congratulate all of the hardworking winners!

item.title: 2019 Southern California Leadership Network Visionaries Awards - Taglyan
item.description: On November 20th, 2019, the Taglyan Complex hosted the Southern California Leadership Network Visionaries Awards, honoring leaders within the community.

item.title: Sold-Out 4th Annual Vanderpump Dog Foundation Gala A Huge Success!
item.description: On November 21st, 2019, the 4th Annual Vanderpump Dog Foundation Gala was held at the Taglyan Complex in order to better the lives of dogs domestically.

item.description: The very exciting Smash Global Black Tie Fight Night, hosted at Taglyan, benefits various charities and entertains the masses.

item.description: Taglyan is the home of the Hollywood Critics Association Awards (HCA)! We love this incredible ceremony and everything that the HCA stands for.
